M4b (the shapes real data needs) — live, 1 Sep 2026, BEFORE apply

WHY IT EXISTS: recording BOPEU's actual contract — the first real data the M4
schema has ever held — hit three walls in the first ten minutes.

BASELINE (confirmed against live)
  org_contracts note/approx columns : NONE — cannot express "approximately"
  amount vs kind constraint         : (contract_kind='retainer') = (retainer_amount IS NOT NULL)
                                      i.e. a retainer MUST carry a bare number
  format check                      : talk, one_on_one, couple, group, webinar,
                                      wellness_day, flyer, other   (no campaign)
  practitioner_kind check           : advisor, counsellor           (no vendor)
  org_contracts rows                : 0
  program_activities rows           : 1

THE PREDICTION
  CHANGES
    org_contracts gains amount_is_approximate (default false) and amount_note,
    plus a constraint that an approximate amount must be explained.
    format admits 'campaign'. practitioner_kind admits 'vendor'.
  DOES NOT CHANGE
    No existing row. Defaults chosen so existing rows keep the meaning they
    have: amount_is_approximate=false says "this number is exact", which is
    what every current row implicitly claims.
    No policy, no grant, no function. Row counts unchanged.
  NOT ADDED ON PURPOSE
    group_session — `group` already means that, and two values for one idea
    means half the rows use each within a month.
  IF IT IS WRONG
    A widened check admitting a value nothing reads yet. Both changes are
    additive; no existing value is removed.
